title: 莫纳什大学团队在 Weather and Climate Dynamics 发表热带降雨关键天气系统追踪成果
originalTitle: More important than tropical cyclones: Scientists finally track the hidden weather systems behind most tropical rainfall
summary: 莫纳什大学团队在《Weather and Climate Dynamics》发表研究，首次将热带降雨中的湿度模态定义为可追踪天气系统，并揭示其占极端降水45%-75%。
